scope: Flat event-period weights, not isolated function timings or p95 latency. Three separate instrumented repeats. Interrupts inside each active worker interval can contribute. Host interference remains uncertain. RCU and return-thunk costs cannot be assigned exclusively to task routing. Profile and plain execution shares can differ.
